description: Resolve domain names, IP addresses and DNS resource records; introspect and reconfigure the DNS resolver.

next.name: default-route
tip: Get/set whether a link may be used as default DNS route.

next.name: dns
tip: Get/set per-interface DNS servers.

next.name: dnsovertls
tip: Get/set per-interface DNS-over-TLS mode.

next.name: dnssec
tip: Get/set per-interface DNSSEC mode.

next.name: domain
tip: Get/set per-interface search and route-only domains.

next.name: flush-caches
tip: Flush all DNS resource record caches.

next.name: llmnr
tip: Get/set per-interface LLMNR mode.

next.name: log-level
tip: Get/set logging threshold for systemd-resolved.

next.name: mdns
tip: Get/set per-interface MulticastDNS mode.

next.name: monitor
tip: Show a stream of local client resolution queries and responses.

next.name: nta
tip: Get/set per-interface DNSSEC NTA domains.

next.name: openpgp
tip: Query PGP keys stored as OPENPGPKEY resource records.

next.name: query
tip: Resolve domain names, IPv4 and IPv6 addresses.
With --type or --class, resolve low-level DNS resource records.

next.name: reset-server-features
tip: Flush learned feature level information for servers.

next.name: reset-statistics
tip: Reset resolver statistics counters.

next.name: revert
tip: Revert per-interface DNS configuration.

next.name: service
tip: Resolve DNS-SD and SRV services.

next.name: show-cache
tip: Show current cache content, per scope.

next.name: show-server-state
tip: Show detailed server state information.

next.name: statistics
tip: Show resolver statistics.

next.name: status
tip: Show global and per-link DNS settings.

next.name: tlsa
tip: Query TLS public keys stored as TLSA resource records.

option.name: --cache
tip: Use the local DNS resource record cache for lookups.

option.name: --class
tip: Specify the DNS resource record class, e.g. IN, ANY.
Use help to list known values.

option.name: --cname
tip: Follow CNAME or DNAME redirections.

option.name: --help
tip: Show this help.

option.name: --interface
tip: Specify the network interface to query on.

option.name: --json
tip: Output as JSON.
Possible values: pretty, short, off

option.name: --legend
tip: Show column headers and meta information about the query response.

option.name: --network
tip: Allow lookups to be answered via DNS, LLMNR or mDNS network requests.

option.name: --no-ask-password
tip: Do not ask for system passwords.

option.name: --no-pager
tip: Do not pipe output into a pager.

option.name: --protocol
tip: Specify the network protocol for the query.
Possible values: dns, llmnr, llmnr-ipv4, llmnr-ipv6, mdns, mdns-ipv4, mdns-ipv6, help

option.name: --raw
tip: Dump the answer as binary data.
Without a value or with payload, the packet payload is exported.
With packet, the whole packet is dumped in wire format.

option.name: --relax-single-label
tip: Relax routing rules for single-label names.

option.name: --search
tip: Search single-label hostnames in the configured search domains.

option.name: --service-address
tip: Resolve hostnames in SRV records when doing a service lookup.

option.name: --service-txt
tip: Resolve the TXT service metadata record when doing a DNS-SD lookup.

option.name: --stale-data
tip: Answer lookups with stale (expired) data if possible.

option.name: --synthesize
tip: Resolve select domains locally, such as localhost and /etc/hosts entries.

option.name: --trust-anchor
tip: Answer DS and DNSKEY lookups from local DNSSEC trust anchors.

option.name: --type
tip: Specify the DNS resource record type, e.g. A, AAAA, MX.
Use help to list known values.

option.name: --validate
tip: Apply DNSSEC validation to the query.

option.name: --version
tip: Show package version.

option.name: --zone
tip: Answer lookups from locally registered LLMNR or mDNS records.
Resolve IPv4 addresses only.
Resolve IPv6 addresses only.

option.name: -j
tip: Same as --json=pretty on tty, --json=short otherwise.
